# The Unique Choice

> Sourcing agent connecting international buyers with verified factories and suppliers in China & Hong Kong — sourcing, factory inspection, secure payments, and door-to-door shipping.

## About

- Founder: Vishal Saini
- Services: supplier sourcing, factory inspection, verified suppliers, secure payment handling, product inspection before shipping, door-to-door freight, and small-parcel shipping
- Regions served: Hong Kong, India, South Africa
- Contact: WhatsApp/phone +91 98967 39100, email hello@theuniquechoice.com
